text:
incident-bot: Pager triggered: billing.metering.alert -> token-count-drift (severity: P2). Spike in shadow vs primary counts across eu-west ingest. Auto-notify to #incidents and on-call.

oncall: I'm on it, taking page. tagging @Maya K and @Arjun P for help.

Maya K: quick check on console: embeddings pipeline shows ~0.7% fewer tokens emitted from emitter-2 over last 90m. latency and throughput look normal.

Arjun P: looking at kafka: consumer group meter-ingest-v2 shows lag grown from 0 -> 125k around 2024-11-12T02:15Z. offsets stuck at 1243123.

Arjun P: running: 
```
kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server kafka-eu:9092 \
  --group meter-ingest-v2 --describe | grep ingest-topic
```

Diego: I see a burst of rebalances in the broker logs at same time, plus a couple of failed commit attempts: "Commit failed: OffsetOutOfRangeException".

Maya K: customer impact? any overage flags firing?

Billing-SRE: Not seeing billing spikes in totals yet, but overage flags (early detectors) increased for 9 customers in eu-west, mostly because shadow emitter emitted fewer tokens and the reconciliation job still used primary counts for alerts. No invoices changed.

oncall: action plan: 1) pause alerting that feeds customer-facing overage emails, 2) enable fallback emitter for ingest-v2, 3) start backfill for missed window, 4) open postmortem ticket.

Maya K: pausing external overage email feed now: `ops-alerts pause channel=customer-overages --reason="ephemeral metering ripple"` :white_check_mark:

Arjun P: enabling fallback emitter slot `fallback-emitter-eu-01` (low-risk): `deployctl start fallback-emitter-eu-01 --target=ingest-v2` -> OK, health checks passing.

Arjun P: kicking an immediate backfill job for offset range 1243124..1244370 using consumer-backfill tool.

Diego: starting reconciliation query to enumerate affected customers:
```
SELECT customer_id, sum(tokens_primary) AS primary, sum(tokens_shadow) AS shadow
FROM metering.shadow_vs_primary
WHERE event_time >= now() - interval '3 hours'
GROUP BY customer_id
ORDER BY (primary - shadow) DESC
LIMIT 50;
```

Billing-SRE: good. please tag me with the reconciliation output. I'll run a safe suppression for alerts for any customer with delta < 1%. For >1% we notify engineering + account owner.

Maya K: note: this looks like a transient consumer rebalance caused by a gzipped index compaction on broker-3. Ops infra scheduled compaction auto-tune kicked in. Filing infra followup.

oncall: summary for pager: fallback emitter up, backfill started, external overage emails paused, replication lag being drained. ETA to reconcile initial window ~45-60m. If backfill finishes earlier we'll unpause alerts and reconcile alerts.

incident-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-2024-8843 (ephemeral-billing-ripple). Assigned: oncall, Maya K, Arjun P, Diego.

Billing-SRE: I'll watch for customer-facing impacts, prepping a short FAQ in #customer-success in case of questions.

oncall: thanks team. keep updates here — every 10-15m or on major milestone. :thumbsup:
